balls.text: Dougie has finished off with two nerveless overs, despite that slippery full toss that went for a six. He gets the last one to squeeze under Symmo's bat outside off as he looks to chop it away. They think of a single, but Dhoni collects and prances up to the stumps to deny them the run.
monster bouncer that. 137 kph on a length and it shoots away. Might have hit a patch of grass or something, it went well over the batsman's head.

lovely bowling. 123 kph offcutter, Pollard did not pick it at all as he looked to pull. They run a bye as Dhoni can't collect cleanly. Dhoni picks it up eventually and fires a really poor throw, and might have twisted his ankle in the process.
escapes with a near wide, Pollard stands back in the crease and backs away, Bollinger keeps it full and wide of off stump. Pollard can't reach it.
short of a length outside off, Symonds under edges to Dhoni and they hare across.

No 100 to be had, but this has been a top innings nevertheless. Bollinger rolls the fingers over this one and keeps it short of a length outside off. Rohit looks to go back in the crease and heave this over the on side, but it never comes on. He mishits it straight to long on.
short ball, hurries onto Symonds who pulls and gets hit in the midsection now. He winces as he runs across, and Rohit is at the other end in no time. He wants a 100.
Symonds pushes  a single to end the over. Poor one from Raina.

Chennai have lost it somewhat. This time Vijay, from long on, doesn't go for a catch since he assumes midwicket running back will. Rohit looks for another six, but doesn't get much on it this time. Safe though.

this is brutal. Rohit and Raina are fighting for one spot in the Indian side, and Rohit is trying to settle the debate out there. Another poor length ball from Raina, Rohit lines him up and catapults a lofted on drive out of the field.

dropped. Calling is not in fashion in this IPL. Full and on leg stump from Raina, Rohit looks to slog sweep, but is too close to the ball and top-edges it behind square leg. Hussey and Badri converge on the ball, both go for it, both dive, both drop and someone, both escape from clunking their heads into one another.
horror ball. Raina lands this short and at a really amiable pace, Rohit gladly pulverises it over wide long on
spears the first one in full and Symonds drags it to midwicket for one

Rohit ruins the over with a superb shot. Bollinger was looking for the yorker, but the ball slipped out and ended a full toss at waist height. Rohit was shuffling across already and the kept his wits about him to play the lap shot, all the way over Dhoni's head.
clever, clever stuff. Bollinger sees Rohit wandering to the leg side this time and pushes the ball full and wide outside off, Rohit could not reach it.
another hustling short ball, Symonds looks to make room and swat it, and ends up mis-timing a single down the ground.
smart ball, Bollinger cramps Symonds outside off and doesn't give him length either as he motors out of the crease. He ends up looking to carve through the off side, but misses
another short ball, Rohit looks to pull again and edges onto the pad for a single to the leg side
short ball, not short enough to pull and Rohit is hit in the tummy as he swings and misses. Ouch.
yorker of sorts to end the over, Rohit pushes it into the covers to retain strike
well bowled, skids the full offspinner on leg stump, past Rohit's defence and just past the leg stump
again Symonds looks to cart him straight, but can't get much behind this one. On the bounce to long on.
poor from Chennai, they give away an overthrow after Symonds worked him with the angle to square leg
oh boy, this is brutal. He's tonked a full ball well outside off over long on with a swiped drive. The timing was immense.
Ashwin lands this flat on middle, Rohit punches off the back foot past the bowler for a single
better line, Rohit works him off the pads to midwicket where the fielder slips. There is a lot of dew out there.

intelligent batting this from Rohit. The field is set back on the off side, and inside the circle on the leg side. Rohit picks his spot and walks across the stumps. Jogi's pace is such a dawdle, it sits up on middle and Rohit pulls it over Morkel at square leg. He runs back and puts it a slide, but the ball wins.
this time he lands it well outside off in the mid-120s. Symonds has a huge swipe at it and gets it down to third man

Symonds sends him into downtown Mumbai. Hapless length stuff from Joginder, on the stumps and despite Symonds' reluctance to get forward, this is in the slot. He pile-drives it just over the head of long-on.
angles into the pads, Rohit works him with the angle through square leg for a single
is cannon fodder. Polite length ball outside off, Rohit gets to the line and murders it through the covers.
beats him outside off with a quick floater, Symonds looks to guide through point but misses
skidder on off, played into the off side without fuss
lovely shot, Symonds' muscles come into the pitcture. Full on leg stump again, he just crouches out to the pitch and mows it over the infield. Didn't do much at all, but the ball flew away in fear.
huge appeal, turned down. Very full from Randiv on middle and leg, and it was straightening into the stumps. Symonds was caught on the crease. It was clipping the top of leg stump.
wisely fires this in flat, and Rohit guides backward of point for one

Rohit has hit that almost out of the Wankhede. Typical shot to being up a 50, it lands in the third tier over long off. Randiv tosses it up from round the stumps, Rohit charges out and launches him clean and high.
Rohit times the extra cover push really well and Badri does well to keep it down to a single
this time he gets the single away, in front of square with more assurance.
how did that miss the stumps? Raina gets this ti skid on from middle and Symmo plays all over it as he looks to heave. He might have got an inside egde, and that was really close to the leg stump.
a hint of Laxman in that shot. Short of a length and turning in, Rohit stays back and has all the time in the world to loft it over the short midwicket.
speared in, full on the pads, Symonds clips it from the crease through square leg.
short of a length on off, forced with the spin wide of long-on for a single
short of a length outside off, Rohit steers in front of point for another single
drifts into the pads, Symonds carefully pull-slaps backward of square leg
slides a wide down the leg side
carom ball outside off, Rohit pushes into the off side for a single
Symonds is not picking him at all, the floater that holds its line, is outside edged to point.
loopy ball, worked with the spin to midwicket
turn from outside off, Symmo is playing the spin from the pitch, he isn't picking it. Played with bat and pad close to each other back down the track

When Rohit bats like this, you really wonder why this man isn't a staple in the India line-up. Tossed up from round the wicket, just outside off, Rohit leans out languidly and tees off over extra cover. That was the one area on the off side with no protection. Supreme shot.

unlucky for Randiv, it was his version of the doosra again, doesn't turn away too much but holds its line. Rohit was beaten, but was good enough to adjust and open the face to steer it down to third man.
straightens from middle, Symonds slaps with the turn to square leg
another straighter one, squares of a nervy Symonds who pushes from the crease after getting across. Outside edged towards third man for two
tossed up outside off and turning in, Symonds plays it back down the track
another wide from Randiv, he slips it down the leg side

Rayudu has run right past a straighter one from Randiv. He announced his intent early and gave the charge, Randiv landed the floater short of a length and got it to hold its line. Rayudu was not to the pitch and did not pick the variation as he shovelled to the leg side. Swing and a miss, Dhoni does the rest.
tough of width outside off, Rayudu steers through cover point for a single
Rayudu again tries to work the carom ball from the crease to the leg side, but finds midwicket this time
slower and loopier offie, Rohit nudges with the spin through midwicket
carom ball on off stump, Rayudu sees it and swipes it across to midwicket
Joginder muffs it in the outfield. Tossed up on a length around off and breaking in, Rayudu sweeps it hard, but Jogi at deep square leg moves slowly and comes down late to left it skid through
keeps it short of a length on off stump, Rayudu comes out and then defends.
too straight again to end the over, swept without much control backward of square for a single
again drifts down the leg side, and it is helped along to short fine leg where Badri intercepts
loopy ball on middle, whipped to midwicket
Randiv's lines aren't too good, another one slides down the leg side
more air, Rohit leans out to work it to mid-on
too short, and Rohit is in too good form to let it go. It turns in from well outside off, but Rohit is in position for the cut early and focuses on eluding backward point.
too much turn, drifts down and is called wide.
turn from middle and off line, it is worked with the spin to short fine leg.
straighter one outside off, Rohit times the back foot push through extra cover well and they think of two, but the running is iffy again. They settle for a single.
floater on off stump, Rohit reaches across and defends

this could be trouble. Rayudu might be run out. Another misunderstanding between these two. This time Rayudu wants the run but Rohit doesn't. Full on off, Rohit lunges out and pads it to the off side, Dhoni is off in a flash and throws to Ashwin on the bounce, as Rayudu dives in. The dive might have saved him. That, and the fact that it wasn't the most powerful throw.
big turn from outside off, but it is slow and Rayudu guides to third man for a single
tossed up outside off, worked with the turn down the ground for one.
full toss on middle, Rohit politely punches to long-on for a single.
slow and short, Rayudu waits until eternity and is still so early in the pull, he drags it to long on. He wanted only one, but Rohit hared half way back for the second. He got back in time though.
full and straight on off, Rayudu defends sedately towards mid-off
Rayudu is going for a walk around his crease every ball. This time he is a foot outside the crease, with the feet planted on middle and off as Jogi bends one in a touch.
Rayudu again leaps across with the back foot and then plays a baseball shot, but it is too short and wide.

Fifty up for Mumbai. Rayudu pulls away that innovative lap flick. He shuffles all the way across the stumps and is standing in Shiv Chanderpaul style by the time the ball comes. It is angling into the pads and he slaps it away to the left of fine leg.
full and a foot wide of off stump, this time Rohit gives Jogi more respect. Guided down to third man.
Rayudu again moves all around the crease and then looks to heave a short ball to the leg side. No contact made. He's trying too hard today.
back of a length, and again it ends on the pads. Rohit nudges to the leg side for a single.
over-pitched on the pads, Rohit is getting some gifts today. This one he flicks uppishly past a sluggish Bollinger at mid-on and they get a couple
interesting tactics from Rayudu, initially moves his front foot outside leg, before bringing the back foot to off stump and flicks towards square leg.
Rayudu charges out to Morkel who keeps it back of a length outside off. Play and a miss.

Mumbai finally get a move on. Horrible ball this, slanting a mile down the leg side and Rayudu deserves credit for actually making contact with it as it slid down the leg side and good pace. Pulled with one hand through fine leg.

boy, he's played some real shots today. Joginder lands one short of driving length and angles it into Rohit. What does he do? He gets the front foot half forward, and slap-slams it over long-on for a big six. All timing.
this time he steers a single from off stump line, through third man for a single
Rayudu is not at his best, so far. He's struggling to force the ball away off a slightly two-paced pitch. Short of a length from Jogi, he goes hard at it and mistimes to the leg side
good delivery, nips away a touch from outside off and Rayudu feels for it from the crease
try getting a ball past Raina. Full from Jogi, Rohit leans into an blistering square drive and Raina at short point dives to his left and parries it.
back of a length and just outside off, Rohit undercuts past the off stump.
full and swinging away from Jogi as well, but he's started this well outside off. Rohit leaves. Jogi is coming off a fruitful Ranji season.

for a moment there, Newton was wondering if he should rework the law of gravity. Full and moving away again, Rayudu danced out and threw everything he had at it. He gets a thick outside edge and the ball flies at great pace wide of Hussey at slip. Hussey sees, takes off up and to the right, hangs in mid-air for a moment, thinks about it, puts his right hand behind even as the blur of a cricket ball flies past, and tries to grasp it, but this ball went past in a flash.
legcutter, Morkel gets this to kick up from a length and Rohit does well to drop it to point and take off. Raina can't cut off the single.

Bollinger wasn't moving the ball, but Morkel sure is. Hence what was cover-driven for four last over is an ugly play and miss this time. Rohit gets across and gropes unsuccessfully. The ball is already in Dhoni's gloves.
that's Morkel's first poor ball today, and Rohit cashes in once again. Full and slanted into the pads, Rohit calmly gets inside the line and flicks through midwicket.
another away seamer, just short of a length and going away, Rohit lets it go.
fullish ball, Rayudu gets the feet forward and and pushed wide of mid-on for a single.

the previous shot was textbook, this one was imperious. Bollinger did not over-pitch this one, though it was still there for the drive. It was a gamble, since slip was waiting. Rohit got across and scythed the drive backward of point. The wrists came into play and it was just too elegant to watch.
sublime shot. Full and wide outside off, and for once today a Mumbai batsman moves his feet Rohit gets the front foot across with authority and creams it through point.

Bollinger silences Wankhede. Valthaty keeps the orange cap for now. Tendulkar is gone. Chennai on top. Really good bouncer from Bollinger, dug it in back of a length and got it to climb rapidly on Tendulkar even as it angled across. Tendulkar moved the back foot across to off stump and went for the hook, but he was late on the shot. He gets a feeble top edge that balloons up towards the cordon. Dhoni runs back and gets ready to take it, but Hussey jumped in front of him and took it.
back of a length and looks to cramp Rayudu for room outside off, but Rayudu rides the bounce and dabs it past the slip.

Tendulkar has not got forward to a single ball today. Again stays deep in crease to tackle the late movement and pushes a full ball straight to Vijay running in from mid-off. Tough single, but he makes it.
Bolly aims for Rayudu's pads with an incoming delivery and Rayudu nudges it with the deviation towards fine leg
Breaking news: Morkel has conceded a run. Rayudu gets bat on ball. Gets across to off stump and angles another away seamer to third man.
Rayudu has tried to fish off the back foot, to waft off the front foot, and now he tries to make room as he backs away. And he still can't get bat on these outswingers.
Albie Morkel, right-arm fast legspin. Another one darts away from short of a length. Rayudu walks out and wafts at it, but he is yards away from the ball.
another away seamer, Rayudu gets closer to the line and guides to point
Morkel again gets one to go away, but starts it from well outside off. Rayudu pokes without moving his feet.

Sathish was picked to play out the first over and perish in the second. Unfortunate dismissal there, he really got a piece of that short ball from Morkel but smashed the pull straight to midwicket inside the circle. Sathish was advancing as Morkel bowled it and pulled it off the front foot, and hence got it in front of square.
finishes off with a full and straight ball and Tendulkar can't get much bat on the flick shot.
smart delivery, Bollinger rolls the fingers over this and sends down an offcutter, Tendulkar is fooled as he prances out of the crease and it nips away from him.

smashed. Bollinger gives Tendulkar width once too often, and it is only a matter of time before one of them is thumped through the covers. Tendulkar stays on the back foot and drills it through the line, beating all the fielders inside the circle.
width on offer, Tendulkar gets into perfect position for the flowing square drive, but picks out Raina at short cover-point. He is just in front of square there.
Bollinger has let this fly. There seems to be more carry from the end. He dug this in short alright, but it absolutely took off and went several feet above Tendulkar. Dhoni did not have a chance.
Bollinger again angles one across, full and outside off, Tendulkar shuffles behind the line and defends.
back of a length on off stump, Tendulkar gets behind the line and defends to the off side

Morkel starts with a maiden, and he's got all but one ball in that over to move away devilishly. Sathish again swings wildly in hope but the ball just keeps going away and he misses the line by a lot in the end.
Sathish feels the pressure, he jumps out in search of a hittable length and Morkel again gets it to curve away, Sathish drives hard on the up and nearly hits it straight to Badri at cover.
top stuff from Morkel, he's getting this to bend away nicely. Sathish doesn't move the front foot to the off stump line and gropes inside the line. Play and a miss.
very similar to the first ball, again the ball dies after passing Sathish's flat-footed swish.
slanted in from well wide of the crease, Sathish looks to flick but misses and it struck on the front pad.
seam movement straight away, but no carry. Very wide outside off, Sathish pokes and misses as it moves away.

Mumbai avenge their defeaat the final of IPL 2010. Short of a length on Badri's body, he pulls to deep square leg for two more. He's played a really lovely innings, and is unlucky to be on the losing side.

oh alright. I didn't know that. Pollard can misfield after all. Surprise. Badri again hangs back in the crease and heaves over the leg side, wide of long-on. Pollard runs to his right, has it in his sights and then lets it slip through.
that should be that. Munaf bowls a low full toss on the pads, Badri can't get under it and plays a vicious whip to long on. Who else but Pollard is in the way. They get a couple.
and that's one of them. Badri, the alchemist, produces a six. He gets a length ball angling in, stands back in the crease and slugs it over deep midwicket. Ahemm.
he's missed a slow legcutter. Full and inviting from Munaf at 114 kph, Badri looks to thump straight but it nips away at the last moment. Miss. Four sixes needed now.
manic running. Badri looks to slam a back of length ball through the off side, and hits straight to long-off. He hares back for the second and gets in the way of the throw.

blaster! Bolly looks down tentatively to ensure his legs haven't disappeared. Malinga sends down a ripping yorker than curves in and thuds low on the legs. Was sliding down the leg side and Bolly survives. He will be happy to have a nice set of pads.
another one bites the dust. Randiv gives Sathish catching practice at point. Short and fast on off stump, no room, no nothing. Randiv guides it straight to his hands. Mumbai on the brink.
again Malinga hustles a bouncer past Randiv. He goes for a swish and misses.
Randiv gets one away, full and fast well outside off, he carves it to deep point for a couple.
through him in a trice. Randiv had no clue, wandering out and looking to steer to the off side, but the short ball whizzed by. Should have played Malinga more often in the nets.
sends down the yorker, curving in and Badri can't time the straight drive at all. Single to long on

Harbhajan has five! Who said he can't get wickets? He has bowled like a champ today. Another one tossed up, inviting the loft, and Joginder's heave went no where. Top edge spirals up to the off side of the pitch, Harbhajan and Rayudu converge, Harbhajan calls and takes it.

this fielding is just out of the world. He was jumping and running as if he was on the moon there. Badri leaps out and looks to thump straight, and it goes on the bounce and seems set to get him four. Out of nowhere, Pollard appears, flies in front of the ball and keeps it in play. They get just one.

Harbhajan has four. Chennai are crumbling here. Lovely topspinner, bravely landed up and Ashwin took up the challenge, jumping out and looking to smite it over long on. He did not get a very good connection though, and looped it into Pollard's hands at long-on.
almost a run out, Ashwin whips straight to midwicket and runs down the track. Badri sends him back and he has to dive in  ...

Bhajji has nailed Morkel, and surely Mumbai have sealed it now. Harbhajan was looking to get it as flat and fast and straight as he could. It's a smart strategy in these end overs. Morkel went down on a knee and looked to dump him over cow corner. He swing hard, but the ball slipped through too quickly for him and clattered into off stump. Harbhajan's bowled superbly today.
short and flat, Badri heaves a single to square leg
good yorker, angles in from wide of the crease and ends up in the blockhole, Badri digs it out to long on for one
Morkel moves away, Pollard wisely follows him and restricts him to a glance to short fine leg. No-ball. Only three fielders inside the 30-yard circle. Ragged from Mumbai.
length ball angling in, Badri times the drive well but finds wide long-off.
very full outside off, Morkel drives straight to long-off for a single.
another wide. Mumbai have sent down too many of these. This time down the leg side.
Badri backs away, Pollard sees him and lands this on middle, Badri dabbed it backward of point and gets to a lovely 50.
there's no stopping the submarine. He waddles across the stumps, uses Pollard's angles and laps a nerveless boundary to fine leg.
short ball on the hips, Morkel fends to square leg for a single.

Anirudha holes out, this game continues to swing. Full toss on the stumps, Anirudha swipes it straight to deep midwicket. That deserved to go for six, but he did not connect as cleanly as he would have wanted.
Anirudha throws everything at it, but the ball goes nowhere. Very full and flat on off stump, smart stuff from Harbhajan.
some guts from Badri, going for a reverse sweep to these lines and these angles. Lands on middle and straightens, Badri just manages to get some glove on it even as Bhajji goes up in a huge appeal.
misfield, allows a single that could have been tight. Anirudha forces off the back foot towards mid on and takes off. Rohit runs in and fumbles. A clean collection and a direct hit would have helped.
nice footwork from Anirudha, a bit gully-cricketish as he skips inside the line to let that one slide down the leg side
Badri skips out, Bhajji sees him and keeps it full on leg stump, it is flicked to deep midwicket for one more.
keeps it full and fast at 89 kph on the stumps, Badri defends.
hustles him with a bouncer, Anirudha is early into the pull and swings a full circle and another half a circle thanks to the momentum. The ball dribbles away towards mid on. Another dot ball.
Anirudha tries to back away and create room, but Pollard cramps him and Anirudha forces straight to Tendulkar at mid off
offcutter, nudges the pad on the way to the keeper.

take that says Anirudha. At Pollard's pop gun pace, he really has it coming. Short ball, sits up like a dolly, Anirudha got into a nice position and slammed the pull all the way over square leg. On one leg, finishes with a swagger.
sharp bouncer at 129 kph, Anirudha leaves and it is again wided for height.
Badri again walks out of the crease, and is not given any room so he drops it to the off side for one more
Pollard angles one into Anirudha's pads and he quietly turns it away to square leg for one

Badri produces a boundary to release some pressure, and it is another lovely stroke from the submarine. Short of driving length and cramping him for room, Badri adjusts for both by leaping out and to the leg side. He then caresses it through the covers and the sweeper dives over the ball after doing well to get across.
short ball, Badri leaps out and is in no position to make contact. Called a wide for height.
Anirudha barely manages to ride the bounce, and pops the steer to third man in the air. Safe in the end.
short ball, slants down the leg side, did he get something on it? Huge appeal for caught behind, umpire Saheba calls a wide.
uses the pace outside off, and dabs Malinga down to third man where Harbhajan fields.

Is this the best fielding performance of the tournament? Mumbai have been more horizontal than vertical today. Badri smears a cover drive with some power, Pollard leaps away to his left at cover and stops it.
Badri is getting stuck here. The submarine is anchoring. Fullish ball outside off, he stays beside the line and steers well but finds point.
pacy outside off, back of a length and through Badri in a flash.
slants the last one in, Badri nudges to backward square leg for a single. Chennai are a little stunned after those two wickets.
three successive dots, Badri feels the heat. Short of a length outside off, and he rides the bounce to steer straight at point.
fuller length, angling in, worked with the angle to midwicket
short of a length outside off, dabbed backward of point.

catch of the tournament. This could be the ball that wins it for Mumbai. Pollard keeps producing wickets with his seemingly innocuous balls. This was was heading down the leg side, and Dhoni was eyeing the square leg fence as he went for a flick. He was however a little early on the shot and ended up getting a bizarre leading edge that balooned away to third man. Rohit moved rapidly to his left, dived full-length forward and plucked it. He was smiling like an eager little boy as he came up with it.
back of a length outside off, Dhoni pushes into the covers where Tendulkar dives and stops. Wankhede loves it.
fuller ball on off stump, driven with a reluctant half-cock forward movement, straight to mid off.
thuds one short and outside off, Dhoni hops back and lets it go.
how close was that to danger? 144 kph and full on the pads, Dhoni was early on the flick and got it uppishly past midwicket for two
back of a length and moving away, Dhoni times the steer really well, but Sathish at point did well to cut it off.

Hussey goes. Malinga strikes. Pollard scoops one inches above the turf. It was one of those slow bouncers from Malinga, and it gripped and sat up at Hussey, who was almost on one knee as he tried to swat the pull. He then took his eyes off it, surprised by the lack of pace and the extra bounce. He ended up playing it a little uppishly and could not get it to land before Pollard could get his hands under it, swooping forward at midwicket.
and he gets the first ball to curl away from middle and leg, Badri does really well to get bat on it and get it to the leg side for one. Not the fastest ball, it was 126 kph, and that helped.

big over this for Chennai. Did Tendulkar err in giving Sathish an over? Offcutter, lands outside leg and breaks in, Hussey sets up base on the back foot and crashes the pull to the right of a slow-moving Harbhajan at short fine-leg.
aha, lucky. Hussey plays inside the line as Sathish offcuts another one across him, and manages to get the thick edge to run away really fine for four.
slants this too much on leg stump., and he can't afford to at this pace. Hussey laps it over short fine leg and Rohit does well to cut it off after running across from deep square leg
keeps this short of a length, and it never comes along. Badri deflects it into the covers off the back foot for one more.
another full delivery at 94 kph, Hussey drives down the ground for one more
full and slowish offcutter outside off, Badri nudges with the deviation towards midwicket
Badri calmly drives the last ball past mid-on for one more single. 81 required off 10, and we could have a close finish here.
Munaf is flirting with danger at third man. Barely got behind that glide from Hussey that was hurtling towards his in a hurry. He just managed to grasp the ball without over-running it.
short ball outside off, Hussey steers and looks for a single, but Sathish at point does well to cut it off.
angled into Badri's pads, he jumps inside the line and glances backward of square
better line, keeps it outside off but too full and Hussey drives fluently for one more
lousy ball. Right arm over, filth. Wafts a short ball nice and juicy on the hips and Hussey swats the pull to deep backward square leg.
edgy for a change, but it is going his way so far. Rohit skids one along the turf outside off and Badri plays inside the line and gets a couple as short third man slides and fumbles.

If you want to get your brand name on Badri, don't go for the bat face. Go for the elbow. It will get a lot of play. He trots to the pitch of the ball and launches Rohit straight down the ground for six. And then shows us the high elbow. Click away, oh papparazzi.
tossed up on the toes, Hussey works it through the leg side for one
loopy ball on off, Badri works the on-drive with the turn for one more

I want whatever it is that Badri had for dinner. He's timing everything. Rohit gives him a foot of width outside off, Badri dances into position on the back foot and coaxes it between point and short third man. A taste of Rohit's medicine.
back of a length on middle and off, worked against the spin to midwicket for a single.
good bouncer to wind up the over, Badri lets it go just outside off.
fullish on off, Hussey scrambles a single after pushing it to mid-on.
Badri's timing is ominous today. Back of a length outside off at 133 kph, Badri just open the face and sends it scurrying towards third man.
angled across Hussey who calmly glides him down to Munaf at third man for one more.,
better line, but still too straight. Badri works him to midwicket for a single.

If Munaf were a deer, that effort would have been acceptable. Slanted into the pads, Badri glances it along to fine leg and Munaf puts in the big steps. He doesn't dive, but gambols the last few steps like a triple jumper and tries to get the boot in the way. No luck. Hilarious to watch.
tries it again, but this time he doesn't middle the shot and short third man keeps him to a single.

the battery is working alright. Badri plays another shot for the album. Turns in from outside off, cramping Badri for the cut and he chooses to instead just help it along with an opened face. Short third man runs back to fetch.
back of a length outside off, Hussey safely dabs in front of point for a single.
more flight, driven against the spin through mid off for a single.
Hussey plays from the crease to a ball tossed up from round the stumps, and nudges a single to midwicket. Harbhajan runs after it and fields
Bhajji is getting some nice drift going, another one curls in from outside off, Badri covers the line and whips to midwicket
very full to end the over, Badri forces it down the track for a single
that's the length. Munaf keeps it a foot and a half shorter than the previous one and gets it to go away. Badri nearly nicks it too.

that high elbow is worth going miles to watch. Full again from Munaf, he is over-pitching habitually today. Badri leans into the off drive, smokes it through the line and holds the pose as the ball screams away to the right of mid off.
full and straight, textbook forward defensive from Badri. You won't see much of that in the IPL.
width outside off, Hussey gets a single away cutting in front of point.
over-pitched again outside off, Hussey mistimes the drive to the leg side and Munaf does well to collect and fling it at the striker's end. Hussey gives him a stare.
tossed up on off, Badri reaches out to smother and dabs into the covers.

he's done him. Harbhajan's lured Raina out of the crease with a seemingly looping, tossed up offering on off, but he had imparted vicious drift on that. Lovely delivery, it dipped on Raina as he charged out and landed at least a foot short of where he expected. Having not reached the pitch, Raina tamely scooped it back at Harbhajan, who held a sharp catch.
tossed up this time, Hussey reaches out and drives to mid off for one.

aha, Raina loots a single, stands back on the crease and nudges from the pads to short midwicket. Harbhajan flies after it, collects and throws, but Raina dives in .. and ouch.. he is hit flush on the helmet.
short this time, Hussey plays an agricultural pull and gets a single to midwicket.
big appeal, turned down. Skids the first ball onto Hussey from round the wicket and he got an inside edge onto the pads. Bhajji had Hussey in a lot of strife in the Test series last year ...
ends with one on the pads, Raina whips straight to midwicket

he really needs to keep the length short of driving area every time, since his lack of pace makes it too easy otherwise. Raina just leans out and meets a full ball on the top of the bounce, and like Hussey, he just had to beat the widish mid-off. Easily done.

out of nowhere, Munaf has produced a gem. Vijay has been sent packing by a stunning legcutter. It looked like another friendly delivery angling in. Seemed to be doing something, but seamed to do something else. Munaf jagged that away off the seam, Vijay was caught amidships after getting half across and not forward. He was squared up and the outside edge went clean into Rohit's lap at first slip.
slightly short of a length this time, Hussey gets half across and chops backward of point for one

carved. Fuller and wider, he wants Hussey to edge one of these, but Hussey is just going up and away, hitting cleanly through the line, and getting it over the infield. The covers did not have a chance.
nothing ball from Munaf, Hussey tucks in. Full and inviting on off stump, with mid-off inside the circle and not too straight. Hussey just looked to hit straight and got four for it.
beats him for pace to end the over, that buzzed by short of a length and Vijay aborted pulling plans in a hurry
that's Vijay's trademark blow, the shovel-slapped pull to a ball that isn't quite short. He just leaps into position and thumps it from off stump, emphatic and over the deep square leg fence.
aha, that stopped on Vijay. 139 kph but it seemed to bounce extra as Vijay was early on the flick. Leading edge pops up but lands safe near his feet.
keeps it around off stump this time and Vijay steers from the crease to point, who dives and saves
Nechim again slips down the leg side, Vijay twinkles inside the line and glances it a touch uppishly, but it lands away from Harbhajan at short fine leg and goes for four.
slides this one well down the leg side. Another wide.
back of a length and hurries onto Hussey who is caught on the crease. He gets it away to the off side and they get a single
back of a length outside off, Vijay lets it whistle past.
well, they are being a little too strict with these wides. Another one outside off.
lands this short of a length and at great pace. Hussey stays behind and dabs it to third man who has to hurry across as it hurtles to him on the bounce.

inches away from being a yorker, and it ends up a low full toss in the slot for the flick. Hussey times the shot particularly well, but a horizontal Rohit jumps in the way. Some really good fielding on display.
back of a length on the stumps, Vijay tucks it softly to midwicket and Hussey hares across for a quick single.
another near yorker, but there was room outside off for Hussey to push it to mid-off for a single.
starts off with a monster yorker that curls away after starting on leg stump line. Vijay does really well to get the toes out of the way and steal a single to the off side
back of a length outside off and moving away, Hussey lets it go.
on the toes this time, and Hussey charms the flick away. Franklin at midwicket dives in the way.
called wide, and that's a very poor call. Surely wasn't wide enough outside off
that's some cover cordon. Symmo, Pollard and Sharma. This time it is Symonds, back of a length outside off and punched by Hussey, Symonds leaps onto it. Even Harbhajan likes it!
better length, holds it back and gets it to slant across at 132 kph, Hussey lets it go
full again, and crisply timed cover drive from Hussey. He finds cover this time
Hussey starts off with a risky four. Munaf slants this across full and invites the drive, Hussey walks into the shot and lofts it over Pollard at point. Just.
